other_new_defects.quote: On `escalation`, it records the escalation verbatim in the phase report and keeps looping; only `worker_done` ends the loop.
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: The new step 3 loop has no attempt cap or overall timeout, so a crashed, stalled, fenced (WC-12) or retried-away worker makes the live check loop forever instead of failing; an agentWait observation in step 2 also does not stop the loop.
